description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application using React Native. It extends ReactActivity and configures the main component name, React Native architecture features (Fabric and Concurrent React), handles configuration changes, and overrides the back button behavior.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity class extending ReactActivity, serving as the entry point for the React Native application on Android.

methods.name: getMainComponentName
methods.description: Returns the name of the main React Native component, 'StandardNotes'.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the activity is created; here it calls the superclass method with null argument.

methods.name: createReactActivityDelegate
methods.description: Creates and returns a ReactActivityDelegate with configurations for Fabric and Concurrent React based on architecture settings.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes such as dark mode; delegates the change to ReactInstanceManager.

methods.name: invokeDefaultOnBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides back button behavior to move the app to background instead of closing it.
